notes: Editor layout toggle. The full-screen editor now has a 'Layout: Scene Editor / Timeline' switch in the top bar, right of 'Scene X/N'. Scene Editor (default) is the focused single-scene workspace (content rail + big preview + inspector + compact timeline). Timeline promotes the whole-video multi-track timeline to fill the screen — all scenes plus the Voice / Text / Media channels — for arranging, reordering and trimming, with a compact preview on top. The choice persists in localStorage and applies on every editor open.
